name: Batik
description: A wax-resist dyeing method where wax is drawn on cloth before dyeing.
process: Draw wax design, dye, remove wax, repeat for more colours.

name: Handloom
description: Cloth woven by hand on a wooden loom, common in village industries.
process: Prepare warp threads, weave weft by hand, finish and wash.

name: Ikat
description: Threads are tie-dyed before weaving so the pattern appears as the cloth is woven.
process: Tie and dye yarn, set on loom, weave to reveal the design.

name: Block Print
description: Carved wooden blocks stamp repeating motifs onto fabric.
process: Carve block, apply dye, stamp cloth, fix colour.

name: Hand Embroidery
description: Decorative stitching added to woven cloth with needle and thread.
process: Mark design, stitch with cotton or silk thread, press.
